mapper.sql: e.eval_id, e.period_id, p.period_nm, e.evaluatee_id, ue.name AS evaluatee_name, de.dept_nm AS evaluatee_dept, e.evaluator_id, ur.name AS evaluator_name, e.scores_json, e.final_score, e.grade_cd, e.comment, e.created_at, e.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_eval_period (period_nm, start_dt, end_dt, status_cd) VALUES (#{periodNm}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'PLANNED'))
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_eval_period SET status_cd = #{statusCd} WHERE period_id = #{periodId}
mapper.select: SELECT period_id, period_nm, start_dt, end_dt, status_cd FROM gw_eval_period WHERE period_id = #{periodId}
SELECT period_id, period_nm, start_dt, end_dt, status_cd FROM gw_eval_period WHERE status_cd = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY start_dt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT period_id, period_nm, start_dt, end_dt, status_cd FROM gw_eval_period ORDER BY start_dt DESC
SELECT form_id, form_nm, items_json FROM gw_eval_form WHERE form_id = #{formId}
SELECT form_id, form_nm, items_json FROM gw_eval_form ORDER BY form_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_eval (period_id, evaluatee_id, evaluator_id, scores_json, final_score, grade_cd, comment) VALUES (#{periodId}, #{evaluateeId}, #{evaluatorId}, #{scoresJson}, #{finalScore}, #{gradeCd}, #{comment})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_eval SET scores_json = #{scoresJson}, final_score = #{finalScore}, grade_cd = #{gradeCd}, comment = #{comment}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eval_id = #{evalId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_eval e JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = e.period_id JOIN gw_user ue ON ue.user_id = e.evaluatee_id JOIN gw_user ur ON ur.user_id = e.evaluator_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept de ON de.dept_id = ue.dept_id WHERE e.eval_id = #{evalId}

SELECT FROM gw_eval e JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = e.period_id JOIN gw_user ue ON ue.user_id = e.evaluatee_id JOIN gw_user ur ON ur.user_id = e.evaluator_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept de ON de.dept_id = ue.dept_id WHERE e.period_id = #{periodId} ORDER BY ue.dept_id, ue.name

SELECT FROM gw_eval e JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = e.period_id JOIN gw_user ue ON ue.user_id = e.evaluatee_id JOIN gw_user ur ON ur.user_id = e.evaluator_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept de ON de.dept_id = ue.dept_id WHERE e.period_id = #{periodId} AND e.evaluator_id = #{evaluatorId} ORDER BY ue.name

SELECT FROM gw_eval e JOIN gw_eval_period p ON p.period_id = e.period_id JOIN gw_user ue ON ue.user_id = e.evaluatee_id JOIN gw_user ur ON ur.user_id = e.evaluator_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept de ON de.dept_id = ue.dept_id WHERE e.evaluatee_id = #{evaluateeId} ORDER BY p.start_dt DESC
